race.comment: OFF THE RICHTER (5) has the most appealing recent platform after finishing third at this track, beaten just under two lengths. His Ascot run prior had excuses after he was tightened early and held up, so he has more substance than a three-start maiden normally brings. SO MUCH AURA (11) was only beaten just under two lengths at York and gets weight relief third-up. Back up in trip now looks a good move and she can run an improved race. STERN PLAYER (10) shaped well enough first-up when fourth at Belmont Park, beaten just over three lengths, and the interference near the 150m adds merit to that return from mid-week company. ON CLOUD WINE (12) is the debut runner with the right stable profile, a 1.5kg claim and a Lark Hill trial base. She comes into calculations. BIG MARE (3) ran a better race last start and can run an improved race third-up.
